description: This file contains utility functions related to internationalization (i18n) processes, including hashing, normalization, environment variable handling, and segment ID generation, used for managing localized documentation segments in the openclaw project.

methods.name: cacheNamespace
methods.description: Generates a namespace string based on workflow version, engine name, provider, and model, used for caching purposes.

methods.name: cacheKey
methods.description: Creates a SHA256 hash-based key for caching segments, based on namespace, source language, target language, segment ID, and text hash.

methods.name: hashText
methods.description: Computes a normalized SHA256 hash of the input text.

methods.name: hashBytes
methods.description: Computes a SHA256 hash of the given byte slice.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the start and end of the text and replaces sequences of whitespace with a single space.

methods.name: docsPiProvider
methods.description: Determines the documentation internationalization provider based on environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: docsPiModel
methods.description: Selects the model used for i18n based on provider and environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: segmentID
methods.description: Generates a segment ID combining a relative path and a truncated hash of the text.

methods.name: splitWhitespace
methods.description: Splits input text into three parts: leading whitespace, core text, and trailing whitespace.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Outputs an error message to standard error and exits the program if an error is provided.
